title: Rapid-MLX 1.0.2 adds local Pika H3 Flex video+audio and Idle Unload on Mac

appearances.title: Rapid-MLX 1.0.1 adds five local speech models on Mac
appearances.summary: Rapid-MLX 1.0.1 runs five speech models fully on a Mac. Granite Speech 5.0 transcribed 30 seconds of audio in 0.05 seconds, about 640 times real time. Nemotron 3.5 ASR covers 40 locales, FireRedASR2 is reported at 3% character error on Mandarin, and VoxCPM2 plus MOSS-TTS-Nano add local text-to-speech.

appearances.title: Rapid-MLX 1.0 adds a local agent and faster Mac inference
appearances.summary: Rapid-MLX 1.0 serves 240+ open models on Apple Silicon through an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API, and reports up to 4x faster local inference. It adds a local coding harness that can search, edit files, and run tests, and it can generate MiniMax-H3 video with synced audio on a Mac. appearances.title: Rapid-MLX 0.16.8 ships Flint as a pinned alias and doubles concurrent MTP throughput
appearances.summary: Flint 40B-A2.5B now installs from a release with an alias pinned to the benchmarked checkpoint (rapid-mlx serve flint-40b-a2.5b-4bit). Concurrent MTP chats now decode together: 4 parallel Qwen3.8-27B requests went from 35 to 75 tok/s on a Mac.

appearances.title: Rapid-MLX 0.16.5 runs DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 on Mac
appearances.summary: Rapid-MLX 0.16.5 serves a mixed-precision MLX build of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 that keeps the full 40 by 384 expert layout, with a reported KL divergence of 0.439 and about 20 tok/s on an M3 Ultra. The same release adds MiniCPM-V 4.7 and LFM2.5-24B-A2B; the DeepSeek alias is greedy and text-only, with no tool calling and an 8,192-token input cap.
